description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller named IndexController that handles HTTP GET requests for various routes such as '/', '/index', '/discover', '/login', and '/logout-success'. It logs a message when the home page is accessed and returns corresponding view names.

classes.name: IndexController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling routing for index, discover, login, and logout pages.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles root and /index GET requests; logs access and returns 'index' view.
